The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has released the KEA CAR DAR Result 2026 for the written examination held for recruitment to Armed Police Constable (CAR/DAR) posts. Candidates who appeared for this exam can now check their result and download their scorecard through the official KEA portal, cetonline.karnataka.gov.in. This article covers everything currently confirmed by KEA about the result key dates, download steps, what the result PDF contains, and the stages that follow.

KEA CAR DAR Result 2026 - Quick Overview

Particulars Details
Recruiting Body Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
Recruitment Name KEA CAR DAR Recruitment 2026
Post Name Armed Police Constable (CAR/DAR)
Total Vacancies 1,600
Exam Mode Offline (Written Examination)
Exam Date September 6, 2026
Answer Key Released September 7, 2026
Objection Window Start September 9, 2026 (10:30 AM)
Result Date September 11, 2026
Login Details Required Application Number & Date of Birth
Selection Process Written Exam → PET → Document Verification → Medical Examination
Official Website cetonline.karnataka.gov.in

Important Dates

Event Date
KEA CAR/DAR Written Exam September 6, 2026
Provisional Answer Key Released September 7, 2026
Objection Window Opened September 9, 2026 (10:30 AM)
KEA CAR DAR Result Released September 11, 2026

Also Read: RRB Section Controller Exam Date 2026 

How to Download KEA CAR DAR Result 2026

KEA has activated the result download link on its official recruitment portal. Candidates need their Application Number and Date of Birth to log in and view their result. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official KEA website: cetonline.karnataka.gov.in.
  2. Locate the "KEA CAR DAR Result 2026" link on the homepage or under the CAR/DAR 2026 examination section.
  3. Click on the active result link to open the login page.
  4. Enter your Application Number and Date of Birth.
  5. Submit the details to access your result dashboard.
  6. Your result and qualifying status will be displayed on the screen.
  7. Download and save the Result PDF for future reference in the selection process.

Details Mentioned on the KEA CAR DAR Result PDF

  • Candidate's Name
  • Register Number and Application Number
  • Category (UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS)
  • Exam Date
  • Paper (KK & RPC)
  • Version Code
  • Marks Obtained
  • Qualifying Status

Also Read: Mizoram PSC Junior Grade Departmental Exam Result 2026

Important Instructions

  • Keep your Application Number and Date of Birth handy before logging in to check the result.
  • Download and save multiple copies of the Result PDF, since it will be required for later stages of selection.
  • Cross-check all personal details (name, category, register number) shown on the result for any discrepancy.
  • Rely only on the official KEA website for updates on the final answer key, cut-off marks, and PET schedule.
  • The result and scorecard are based on the provisional answer key; the final result will follow the final answer key after objection review.

This article explains the vacancy breakup, provisional selection basis, PwBD category status, and important instructions for candidates, based strictly on the official notice.

Basis and Conditions of Provisional Selection

As per the official notice, candidates have been provisionally selected on the basis of the written examination and document verification conducted for this post. The selection is subject to the following conditions:

  • Candidates must fulfil the prescribed medical examination standards.
  • All submitted documents (educational qualification, experience, caste certificate, etc.) must be found valid and genuine.
  • If any document submitted by a finally selected candidate is found false or invalid, the candidature for the post will be liable to cancellation.

Also Read: RPSC Assistant Professor Final Answer Key 2026

Important Instructions Regarding Court Cases

The notice clearly states that the selected category, marks, and other details of candidates can be published only after the outcome of cases pending before the Hon'ble Court, since the provisional selection result is subject to the outcome of these court cases. The allocation and eligibility of candidates against the pending posts will be subject to the final decision of the Hon'ble Court.

Documents Typically Verified

Based on the notice, the following documents are referenced as part of the verification process. The complete checklist/list of documents is not detailed in this particular notice; only these categories are mentioned:

  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Experience certificates
  • Caste certificate (where applicable)

Any additional document requirements (photo ID, medical fitness certificate format, PwBD certificate, etc.) are not specified in this notice.

How to Check the Provisional Result

  1. Visit the official VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital recruitment webpage.
  2. Locate the notice titled "Provisional Result for the Post of Medical Lab Technologist" dated 09.09.2026.
  3. Open the notice and refer to Annexure-A for the list of provisionally selected candidates along with hospital allocation.
  4. Cross-check your roll number and application number against the annexure.

How to Download the EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026

Sources describe two different ways to access the result a direct PDF download and a login-based portal check. Both methods are listed below since they are not corroborated against each other; candidates should try the official website first to confirm which applies.

Method 1: Direct PDF Download

  1. Visit the official website nests.tribal.gov.in or examinationservices.nic.in.
  2. Look for the link titled "EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026 (Principal Post)."
  3. Open the result PDF and use Ctrl+F to search for your roll number.
  4. Download and save the file, and take a printout for your records.

Method 2: Login-Based Check

  1. Visit the official result portal link on nests.tribal.gov.in.
  2. Log in using your Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth.
  3. View your qualifying status and score details after logging in.

Also Read: 

Documents Required After Qualifying the Tier 2 Result

  • Identity proof: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, or Voter ID
  • Educational documents: Class 10 and 12 mark sheets, degree certificates, postgraduate transcripts
  • Professional certificates: B.Ed degree or relevant teaching diploma, where applicable
  • Valid category/caste certificate, where applicable
  • Tier 2 Admit Card and a saved/printed copy of the EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026

What Happens After the EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify move to the next selection stage. Reported next steps differ slightly between sources, so both are listed below.

  • Document Verification (DV) for all shortlisted candidates
  • Personal interview, specifically for candidates applying to the Principal post
  • Skill Test/Practical Test, for posts where applicable

EMRS Tier 2 Result 2026: Important Instructions

  • Only the Principal post result has been declared as of 3 September 2026 results for other posts are Not Yet Announced.
  • Keep your roll number, registration number, and date of birth handy, since result-check methods reported differ (direct PDF search vs. login-based check).
  • If the official result link does not load immediately, retry after some time rather than assuming an error.
  • The cutoff marks listed in this article are an unofficial, estimated range refer to the official cutoff document on the NESTS website once released.
  • Cross-check post-wise eligibility, application fee, and selection-process details against the official EMRS notification, as some of these figures come from a single aggregator source in this article.

What Is Mentioned in the AFCAT 02/2026 Scorecard

As per the official scorecard format, the AFCAT 02/2026 result document includes:

  • Candidate's Name
  • Roll Number
  • Category
  • Gender
  • Section-wise marks (Verbal Ability, Numerical Ability, Reasoning, General Awareness, Military Aptitude)
  • Total Marks Obtained
  • Qualifying Status
  • Cutoff Marks

What's Next After the AFCAT Result 2026?

Candidates who qualify in the AFCAT 02/2026 written exam move to the next stage of selection:

  1. AFSB Interview: Conducted by the Air Force Selection Board, this includes the Officer Intelligence Rating Test, Picture Perception and Discussion Test, Psychological Tests, Group Tests, and a Personal Interview.
  2. Document Verification: Verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and other relevant documents.
  3. Medical Examination: Candidates who clear the AFSB interview undergo a medical examination.

Documents to Keep Ready for Document Verification

  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Date of birth / age proof certificate
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS, where applicable)
  • AFCAT admit card and scorecard printout
  • Other documents as specified in the AFSB call letter

What to Do If You Did Not Qualify AFCAT 02/2026

  • Next AFCAT Cycle: The Indian Air Force conducts AFCAT twice a year. The next cycle, AFCAT 01/2027, is expected to be announced in December 2026.
  • No Attempt Limit: There is no cap on the number of AFCAT attempts, subject to meeting the age criteria for each cycle.
  • Review Your Scorecard: Check section-wise marks to identify weaker areas to focus on.
  • Practice: Solve previous years' AFCAT papers and take mock tests to improve speed and accuracy.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Keep your AFCAT User ID and Password safe for logging in to check the result and, later, the AFSB call letter.
  • Check both your inbox and spam/junk folder for any OTP-related email from the official portal.
  • Download and save a printed copy of the scorecard once the result is displayed.
  • Rely only on the official website, afcat.edcil.co.in, for authentic updates on the AFSB interview schedule.

How to Download RBI Assistant Prelims Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official RBI recruitment portal at rbi.org.in and go to the "Opportunities@RBI" section, or use the direct score card login link on the official results page.
  2. Click on "Current Vacancies," then locate the RBI Assistant Recruitment 2026 (Panel Year 2025) link.
  3. Open the "Marksheet of Preliminary Examination" or "Score Card" link for the Assistant post.
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number in the first field.
  5. Enter your Password (this is generally your Date of Birth, in DD-MM-YY format).
  6. Type the Captcha code exactly as shown.
  7. Click the Submit button.
  8. Your score card will be displayed on the screen download and save it, or take a printout for future reference.

RBI Assistant Prelims Cut Off 2026

The category-wise and office-wise cut off marks have been released alongside the score card.   • Keep a downloaded copy or printout of the score card for future reference, including for the Mains stage and beyond.

How to Download the HAL Interview Call Letter 2026

HAL has used the same cbexams.com login pattern (Application Number + Date of Birth) at every stage of this recruitment so far for the CBT admit card and the written result. The interview call letter is expected to follow the same process, though candidates should follow the exact on-screen instructions once the link is live, since HAL has not published a separate confirmed procedure for this specific letter in the sources checked.

  1. Visit the official HAL recruitment portal at cbexams.com (the same portal used for registration, admit card, and result) or the Careers section of hal-india.co.in.

  3. Log in using your Application Number and Date of Birth (and Captcha, where prompted).
  4. Your Interview Call Letter should be displayed on screen with interview date, time slot, and venue details.

  • Original and photocopies of educational mark sheets and degree certificate

  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS), if applicable, not older than the validity period prescribed in the official notification

A higher qualification (B.Tech/M.Tech) in relevant fields is treated as value addition, subject to the basic diploma being held.

For the post of SI in Delhi Police, male candidates must possess a valid Driving License for LMV (Motorcycle and Car) on the date fixed for the Physical Endurance and Measurement Test (PE&MT). Male candidates without a valid LMV licence are eligible only for SI posts in CAPFs, not Delhi Police.

  • Fee payment closes 01.10.2026 (23:00 hrs); no other mode of payment is permitted.
  • Fee once paid is non-refundable and non-adjustable against any other examination.
  • Application Form Correction Window (08.10.2026 to 10.10.2026) charges: ₹200 for the first correction, ₹500 for the second correction - applicable to all candidates regardless of gender/category.

SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 Selection Process / Scheme of Examination

The examination consists of four mandatory stages: Paper-I, Physical Standard Test (PST) / Physical Endurance Test (PET), Paper-II, and Detailed Medical Examination (DME).

Paper-I

Part Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
I General Intelligence and Reasoning 25 25 1 Hour (sectional timer of 15 minutes per part)
II General Knowledge and General Awareness 25 25
III Quantitative Aptitude 25 25
IV English Comprehension 25 25

Paper-II

Part Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
I General Intelligence and Reasoning 20 40 1 Hour (sectional timer of 20 minutes per part)
II General Knowledge and General Awareness 20 40
III Quantitative Aptitude 20 40
IV English Comprehension 100 200 1 Hour

Questions in both papers are Objective Multiple Choice Type, set in Hindi and English (Parts I–III). Negative marking: 0.25 marks per wrong answer in Paper-I, 0.50 marks per wrong answer in Paper-II. Difficulty level of Paper-II is higher than Paper-I. NCC Certificate holders get bonus marks: 5% (NCC 'C'), 3% (NCC 'B'), 2% (NCC 'A') of maximum marks in each paper, as on the closing date of application.

Physical Standard Test (PST) – Height & Chest Norms

Height and chest requirements vary by post (SI Delhi Police / SI CAPFs / SI Fire CISF) and candidate category (general, hill areas, Scheduled Tribes, Gorkha, North-Eastern States, etc.), ranging from 154 cm to 170 cm for height depending on category and gender. Female candidates have no minimum chest measurement requirement. Weight must correspond to height for all posts. PST/PET is qualifying/eliminating in nature and does not carry marks. Relaxation in height/chest is permitted only on production of the prescribed competent-authority certificate.

Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must clear the written tests, physical standards and medical standards prescribed for direct recruits.

Medical Examination

All candidates who qualify Paper-II undergo a Detailed Medical Examination (DME) by CAPF Medical Officers. A Review Medical Examination (RME) is conducted for candidates found unfit in DME, preferably the next day; the decision of the Review Medical Board is final. DME/RME is mandatory but qualifying in nature.

Document Verification

Document Verification is conducted by the CAPFs before final result declaration, preferably alongside the DME/RME stage. Candidates must bring two passport-size colour photographs, one original valid Photo ID proof, and originals plus copies of: Matriculation/Secondary Certificate, Educational Qualification Certificate, equivalence order/letter (if applicable), Caste/Category Certificate (if reserved category), Driving Licence (for Delhi Police male candidates), and Ex-Servicemen undertaking/certificates (if applicable).

SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 Indicative Syllabus

  • General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities/differences, space visualization, problem solving, coding-decoding, number/figural series, syllogistic reasoning, Venn diagrams, critical thinking, etc.
  • General Knowledge and General Awareness: Current events, History, Culture, Geography, Economic Scene, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research.
  • Quantitative Aptitude: Number systems, percentage, ratio, averages, interest, profit & loss, time & work, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, mensuration, data interpretation (graphs, histograms, pie charts).
  • English Comprehension: Error recognition, fill in the blanks, vocabulary, spellings, grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms, idioms, comprehension.

How to Apply for SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026

  1. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the SSC website, https://ssc.gov.in. OTR generated on the old website (ssc.nic.in) will not work on the new website.
  2. Log in using your Registration Number and Password, then click 'Apply' against the SSC SI in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination, 2026.
  3. Fill in the Online Application Form either on the SSC website or via the 'mySSC' mobile application (available on Store).
  4. Candidates are advised to opt for Aadhaar-Based Authentication while completing OTR, which exempts them from photo/signature rejection on format grounds and from producing colour photographs/photo-ID at the exam venue.
  5. Capture a live photograph as prompted by the application (no pre-existing photo upload) with good light, plain background, no cap/mask/glasses.
  6. Upload scanned signature in JPEG format (10–20 KB, approx. 6.0 cm width x 2.0 cm height).
  7. Use the Preview/Print option to check all details before final submission.

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the notice for the Combined Higher Secondary Level (CHSL) Examination 2026, inviting online applications for Lower Division Clerk (LDC)/Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) and Data Entry Operator (DEO)/DEO Grade 'A' posts. SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 offers approximately 2,536 tentative vacancies across various Ministries, Departments, and Offices of the Government of India. Applications open on 07 September 2026 and close on 07 October 2026.

In short: SSC is recruiting for LDC/JSA and DEO posts under CHSL 2026, with about 2,536 tentative vacancies. Candidates who have passed Class 12 (or an equivalent exam) from a recognised board can apply. Online applications open on 07 September 2026 and close on 07 October 2026, with fee payment allowed until 08 October 2026. The application mode is online only, via the SSC website or the SSC mobile app, and the posts are located across various Central Government offices in India.

SSC CHSL Eligibility Criteria and Qualification

Eligibility for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 is assessed as on the cut-off date of 07 October 2026, and covers nationality, educational qualification, and age.

Nationality

A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from certain specified countries with the intention of settling permanently in India (candidates in the latter categories require an eligibility certificate from the Government of India).

SSC CHSL Qualification

Post Qualification Required
DEO/DEO Grade 'A' in Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution, SSC, and Ministry of Culture 12th Standard pass in Science stream with Mathematics as a subject, from a recognised Board
LDC/JSA and DEO/DEO Grade 'A' (all other Departments/Ministries) 12th Standard pass or equivalent examination from a recognised Board or University

Candidates who have appeared for their Class 12 exam can also apply, but they must have the qualifying result declared on or before 07 October 2026. Only a declared result counts - a result "under process" does not meet the requirement.

SSC CHSL Age Limit

The age limit for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 is 18 to 27 years, reckoned as on 01 August 2026. This means candidates born not before 02 August 1999 and not later than 01 August 2008 are eligible to apply. Age relaxation is available as per government norms.

SSC CHSL Selection Process

Selection for SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 is through a Computer Based Examination conducted in two tiers.

Tier-I

Part Subject Questions/Marks
I English Language (Basic Knowledge) 25/50
II General Intelligence 25/50
III Quantitative Aptitude (Basic Arithmetic Skill) 25/50
IV General Awareness 25/50

Tier-I consists of objective type, multiple-choice questions only, with a total duration of 60 minutes and negative marking of 0.50 marks per wrong answer.

Tier-II

Tier-II is conducted in two sessions on the same day, comprising four sections: Section-I (Mathematical Abilities and Reasoning & General Intelligence), Section-II (English Language & Comprehension and General Awareness), Section-III (Computer Knowledge Test, qualifying in nature), and Section-IV (Skill Test/Typing Test for DEO and LDC/JSA posts respectively). It is mandatory to qualify all sections of Tier-II. There is negative marking of 1 mark per wrong answer in Sections I and II.

The Department of Posts (India Post), Ministry of Communications, Government of India, has released the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 notification vide Notification No. 17-12/2026-GDS dated 20 August 2026. Applications are invited from eligible candidates to fill tentative vacant posts of Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak in different offices of the Department of Posts across various Circles and Divisions in India. Interested candidates can apply online at the official GDS Online Engagement Portal.

Quick Answer: India Post (Department of Posts) is recruiting for Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) posts - Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak - under the Schedule-II, July-2026 engagement cycle. India Post has announced 23,757 tentative vacancies under the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) engagement. Candidates aged 18-40 years who have passed Class 10 (Secondary School Examination) with passing marks in Mathematics and English, and studied the prescribed local language up to 10th standard, can apply. Online One-Time Registration starts 31 August 2026, and online application submission runs from 2 September 2026 to 21 September 2026 (up to 1700 hrs), at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement, for postings in rural offices of the Department of Posts across India.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for all GDS posts (BPM/ABPM/Dak Sevak) is assessed as on the date of the notification (for qualification) and the last date of application submission (for age), as detailed below.

Educational Qualification Secondary School Examination (SSE)/10th standard pass certificate, with passing marks in Mathematics and English, from a Board recognized by the Government of India/State Governments/Union Territories. Candidates with equivalent qualification from any other board are not eligible.
Local Language Must have studied the local language (as prescribed post-wise for each Circle in Annexure-III of the notification) at least up to 10th standard from a recognized board. Special provisions apply for Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, Sikkim, and Nagaland.
Other Qualifications Knowledge of computers; knowledge of cycling; and adequate means of livelihood besides the GDS allowances (to be submitted as undertakings at the time of engagement)

Note: Past experience or service of any kind is not considered for selection, as per the notification.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Salary (TRCA)

GDS are not regular Central Government employees; they are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carries an annual increase of 3% (subject to fulfilment of conditions under the GDS Rules), along with Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time. GDS are also entitled to GDS Gratuity and the Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to the National Pension System for regular employees).

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

A fee of ₹100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) is payable by applicants for all posts notified in their choice of Division. Payment can be made online through recognized Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or UPI (usage charges as applicable will be levied). The fee, once paid, is non-refundable, and payment must be completed strictly within the application closing date and time (up to 1700 hrs).

  • Fee-exempted categories: All female applicants, SC/ST applicants, PwBD applicants, and Transwomen applicants
  • Applicants who are exempted may submit their application without making any payment

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 40 years, to be determined as on the last date of submission of applications, subject to the following relaxations in the upper age limit.

Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

There is no written examination for GDS engagement. Selection is entirely merit-based, computed from the candidate's Class 10 (SSE) academic record.

  • Applicants are shortlisted on the basis of a system-generated merit list
  • The merit list is prepared from marks obtained (or grades/points converted to marks) in the Secondary School Examination (10th standard), aggregated to a percentage up to 4 decimal places
  • Where only grades are given, marks are computed using a multiplication factor of 9.5 against the grade point (e.g., A1 = Grade Point 10 × 9.5); where CGPA is given, marks are computed as CGPA × 9.5, and the higher of the two (individual subject grades vs. CGPA) is taken if both are provided
  • Candidates must enter marks/grades exactly as shown on their marksheet - mixing marks and grades incorrectly, or entering grades where marks are required, can lead to cancellation/disqualification
  • Tie-breaking in the merit list follows a fixed priority order based on date of birth (older preferred) followed by category and gender combinations (ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, and so on down the prescribed order), with the Department reserving the right to apply additional tie-breaking criteria
  • Shortlisted candidates must undergo physical verification of original documents by the Engaging Authority (Divisional/Unit Head), followed by an offer of provisional engagement, pre-engagement formalities (including 3 days of basic training and arranging accommodation), and final regularization after antecedent and document verification

How to Apply for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only, in two stages - One-Time Registration (OTR) followed by the Online Application Form.

  1. Visit the GDS Online Engagement Portal: https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  2. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) using a valid mobile number and email ID (verified via OTP), entering personal details and Class 10 board/year of passing information, to generate a unique Registration Number
  3. Log in using the Registration Number and password received via SMS, then click "Apply Online" under the "Active Notification" tab
  4. Fill in Personal Details, Board/Educational Details (Circle, Board Name, passing year, marks obtained), and select Division and post preferences based on eligible vacancies
  5. Upload a recent photograph (JPG/JPEG, 30-100 KB, 320×400 px, 4:5 aspect ratio) and signature (JPG/JPEG, 20-100 KB, 300×120 px, 5:2 aspect ratio) as per prescribed specifications
  6. Preview the application and make any corrections before final submission
  7. Pay the applicable fee (if not exempted) through the available online payment modes within 10 minutes of initiating payment
  8. Submit the application on or before the last date, and use the two-day edit/correction window (23-24 September 2026) if any corrections are needed

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate; multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited and will result in cancellation of candidature
  • Candidates are not required to upload documents with the application, only their photograph and signature; original documents are verified physically at a later stage
  • Name, Date of Birth, Father's name, and Mother's name must be entered exactly as recorded in the Class 10 (Matriculation) certificate, failing which candidature may be cancelled
  • Mobile number and email ID, once registered, cannot be modified under any circumstances
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsorily retired from Government service/GDS in the past as a penalty are barred from applying and must submit an undertaking to this effect
  • SSE marksheets of selected candidates may be verified through DigiLocker/API Setu, and candidates must give consent for this verification
  • Candidates dismissed/removed/retired from Government service in the past as a penalty are barred from applying; a false declaration will lead to termination and possible prosecution
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement
  • The Department does not make phone calls to applicants; all correspondence is through the Engaging Authority only, and applicants should be cautious of unscrupulous calls seeking personal information
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason

GAIL (India) Limited, a Maharatna PSU, has announced that it will recruit Executive Trainees (ET) in the disciplines of Chemical, Electrical, Instrumentation, and Mechanical using GATE-2027 marks. This is a pre-advertisement; GAIL will publish the detailed advertisement with vacancy numbers in February 2027, and online applications on the GAIL website will open on 17 February 2027 and close on 18 March 2027.

  • GAIL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

GAIL Executive Trainee (GATE-2027) Recruitment Overview

Particulars Details
Organization GAIL (India) Limited (A Government of India Undertaking, Maharatna PSU)

Note: Only GATE-2027 marks are valid for this recruitment. GATE marks of 2026 or earlier years are not valid.

Post Corresponding GATE-2027 Paper GATE Paper Code

A candidate can apply for one post/discipline only; candidates applying for more than one post/discipline will not be considered.

GAIL Executive Trainee GATE-2027 Eligibility

Educational Qualification

Post Minimum Essential Qualification Equivalent Disciplines/Branches Considered
Executive Trainee (Chemical) Bachelor Degree in Engineering with minimum 65% marks Chemical / Petrochemical / Chemical Technology / Petrochemical Technology / Chemical Technology & Polymer Science / Chemical Technology & Plastic Technology
Executive Trainee (Instrumentation) Bachelor Degree in Engineering with minimum 65% marks Instrumentation / Instrumentation & Control / Electronics & Instrumentation / Electrical & Instrumentation / Electronics / Electrical & Electronics
Executive Trainee (Electrical) Bachelor Degree in Engineering with minimum 65% marks Electrical / Electrical, Electronics & Power / Electrical & Electronics / Electrical & Power
Executive Trainee (Mechanical) Bachelor Degree in Engineering with minimum 65% marks Mechanical / Production / Production & Industrial / Manufacturing / Mechanical & Automobile

Note: Engineering Degree can be B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc. Engg. Candidates with a 5-year integrated B.E./B.Tech. + M.E./M.Tech. dual degree in the relevant discipline are also eligible. Candidates with a 5-year integrated B.E./B.Tech. + MBA or B.E./B.Tech. + M.Sc. are also considered, provided the final percentage meets the notified criteria. Candidates with an engineering degree in a branch/discipline other than those listed above are not eligible. Only full-time regular courses from UGC-recognized/AICTE-approved institutions are considered.

Minimum Qualifying Percentage & Passing-Year Conditions

  • General, EWS and OBC (NCL) candidates: minimum 65% marks in the Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
  • SC/ST/PwBD candidates: minimum 60% marks (a 5% relaxation), applicable only against posts reserved for SC/ST/PwBD. SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts are assessed under general merit standards with no relaxation in minimum qualifying percentage.
  • No rounding off of marks is allowed (e.g., 64.99% is not treated as 65% for UR category).
  • Eligible candidates: those who completed their Bachelor's degree in Engineering in 2026, OR those currently in the final year (2026–27) of their Engineering degree course.
  • Candidates who completed their Engineering degree in 2025 or earlier are not eligible to apply.
  • Final-year candidates must have secured the minimum prescribed percentage (65%/60% as applicable) in aggregate up to the last semester/year examination at the time of applying, and must submit the final degree certificate (or at least a provisional certificate) and all semester/year mark sheets confirming the minimum prescribed percentage by 31 August 2027.

GAIL Executive Trainee GATE-2027 Age Limit

Particulars Details
Upper Age Limit 26 years as on 18 March 2027 (for all four disciplines)

Age Relaxation

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST 5 years
OBC (NCL) 3 years
PwBD 10 years
  • Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) is applicable only against posts reserved for the respective category; if applying against an unreserved post, such candidates are assessed under general merit with no age relaxation.
  • PwBD age relaxation applies irrespective of whether the post is reserved, provided the post is identified suitable for PwBDs.
  • Ex-servicemen with at least six months' continuous service in the Armed Forces may deduct their actual service period from their age; if the resultant age does not exceed the prescribed maximum by more than 3 years, they are deemed to satisfy the age condition.
  • Maximum upper age of the applicant, after all possible relaxations, shall not exceed 56 years.

PwBD-Suitable Categories by Post

Post PwBD Categories Identified Suitable
Executive Trainee (Chemical) Category A: B, LV | Category B: HH | Category C: OA, OL, Dw, AAV | Category D: ASD (M), SLD, MI | Category E: MD involving (A) to (D)
Executive Trainee (Instrumentation) Category B: D, HH | Category C: OL, CP, LC, Dw, AAV | Category D: ASD (M), SLD, MI | Category E: MD involving (B) to (D)
Executive Trainee (Electrical) Category B: D, HH | Category C: OL, Dw, AAV | Category D: ASD (M), SLD, MI | Category E: MD involving (B) to (D)
Executive Trainee (Mechanical) Category B: D, HH | Category C: OA, OL, Dw, AAV | Category D: SLD, MI | Category E: MD involving (B) to (D)

Abbreviations: PwBD – Persons with Benchmark Disabilities; B – Blind; LV – Low Vision; D – Deaf; HH – Hard of Hearing; OA – One Arm; OL – One Leg; CP – Cerebral Palsy; LC – Leprosy Cured; Dw – Dwarfism; AAV – Acid Attack Victims; ASD (M) – Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild); SLD – Specific Learning Disability; MI – Mental Illness; MD – Multiple Disability.

Pay & Compensation

Not specified in this notification. GAIL states it offers "one of the best compensation packages in terms of Cost to Company"; specific pay scale/CTC details are expected in the detailed February 2027 advertisement.

GAIL Executive Trainee GATE-2027 Selection Process

  • GAIL will use GATE-2027 marks (not GATE 2026 or earlier) to shortlist candidates for Executive Trainee recruitment.
  • Eligible candidates must first register for and appear in GATE-2027 in the relevant paper corresponding to their discipline (see Posts & Disciplines table above).
  • After downloading the GATE-2027 admit card, candidates must separately apply online on the GAIL website, indicating their GATE-2027 Registration Number. Applications without a valid GATE-2027 registration number will be rejected.
  • Based on GATE-2027 marks and requirement, candidates will be shortlisted for the further selection process for the Executive Trainee position.
  • Further details of the selection process (e.g., group discussion/interview stages, if any) are not specified in this notification and are expected in the February 2027 detailed advertisement.

How to Apply for GAIL Executive Trainee (GATE-2027)

  1. Register for and appear in GATE-2027 as per the instructions and timelines notified by the GATE-2027 Organizing Institute, in the GATE paper corresponding to your discipline.
  2. Download your GATE-2027 admit card with registration number once activated, from the official GATE website.
  3. Visit the "Careers" section of the GAIL website: https://gailonline.com.
  4. Apply online, indicating your GATE-2027 Registration Number, within the application window: 17 February 2027, 11:00 AM to 18 March 2027, 6:00 PM.
  5. Apply for only one post/discipline; applications for more than one post/discipline will not be considered.

Important: No other means or mode of application will be accepted. Applications without a valid GATE-2027 registration number will be rejected.

Documents/Certificates Required (at Selection Process Stage)

  • GATE-2027 admit card and registration number
  • Final Engineering degree certificate (at least provisional) and mark sheets of all semesters/years, confirming minimum prescribed percentage, to be submitted by 31 August 2027
  • SC/ST caste certificate in the prescribed Government of India format
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed format per DoPT Memo No. 36036/2/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 30-05-2014, issued in the year of advertisement, plus a self-undertaking of OBC (NCL) status at the time of the selection process
  • EWS candidates: latest Income & Asset Certificate (format per DoPT OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt.(Res) dated 31.01.2019), valid for financial year 2026-27, based on income/asset verification for FY 2025-26, submitted at the time of the selection process
  • PwBD disability certificate as per the format prescribed by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment vide notification No. G.S.R. 591(E) dated 15.06.2017, for candidates with specified disability of 40% or more
  • CGPA/OGPA/CPI-to-percentage equivalence certificate from the University/Institute, where applicable
  • Pre-Employment Medical Examination report in the prescribed format, from a Central/State Government Hospital (minimum District Hospital status) or a GAIL-nominated empanelled hospital

Prescribed formats for SC/ST, OBC (NCL), EWS and PwBD certificates can be downloaded from the "Careers" section of the GAIL website: https://careers.gail.co.in.

Important Conditions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • A candidate can apply for one post/discipline only; multiple applications will not be considered.
  • Only GATE-2027 marks are valid for this recruitment exercise; GATE marks of 2026 or earlier are not valid.
  • Candidates who completed their Engineering degree in 2025 or earlier are not eligible to apply.
  • SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates applying against unreserved posts are assessed under general merit, with no relaxation in minimum qualifying percentage or age limit.
  • EWS candidates who fail to produce the Income & Asset Certificate at the time of the selection process will not be allowed to appear for the selection process, and requests for change of category will not be entertained.
  • Appointment is subject to the candidate being medically fit as per GAIL's prescribed standards; GAIL reserves the right to re-examine or review the medical report, and the decision of the designated CMO, GAIL, is final and binding.
  • Any revision, clarification, addendum, corrigendum, or time extension to this advertisement will be hosted only on the "Careers" section of https://gailonline.com; no separate notification will be issued through any other media.
  • Any dispute regarding this recruitment is subject to the jurisdiction of the Delhi High Court only.
  • GAIL has cautioned the general public against dubious agencies/organizations/individuals circulating fake GAIL job advertisements via e-mail, social media, etc.; candidates should rely only on https://gailonline.com for authentic information.

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has invited online recruitment applications under Advertisement No. 11/2026 for recruitment by selection to seven posts spread across different Central Government Ministries, Departments and Union Territory administrations. The posts include Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy and General Medicine), Assistant Editor, Specialist Grade-II (Junior Scale) in Anaesthesiology and Paediatrics, Assistant Public Prosecutor, and Public Law Officer/District Litigation Officer/Law Officer for the UT of Ladakh.

In brief: UPSC is recruiting for 7 distinct posts under Advt No. 11/2026, with a combined total of 212 vacancies. Vacancies range from single-post NDMC specialist roles to 140 posts of Assistant Public Prosecutor in Delhi. Applications are online only via https://upsconline.nic.in, open from 12.09.2026. The closing date is 02.10.2026 (1800 hrs) for all posts except the Ladakh post, which closes 09.10.2026. Selection is by interview (with possible shortlisting/Recruitment Test where the Commission deems necessary).

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Post-wise Vacancy Details

Vacancy numbers, reservation positions, and PwBD suitability/reservation are as notified against each post.

S.No. Post Name Department/Organisation No. of Vacancies
1 Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy) Dept. of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare 4 (UR-01, EWS-01, SC-02)
2 Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine) Dept. of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare 60 (UR-13, EWS-10, OBC-30, SC-05, ST-02; PwBD-03 backlog)

Total vacancies across all seven posts: 212. Several posts carry PwBD-reserved (backlog) vacancies in addition to the general reservation position; posts not reserved for PwBD but identified as "suitable" allow PwBD candidates to apply and be considered on general merit.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Eligibility Criteria (Post-wise)

1. Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy)

  • Age: 40 years for UR/EWS; 45 years for SC.
  • Qualification: Post-Graduate degree in Anatomy (e.g., MS/MD/DNB Anatomy, or MBBS with MSc Anatomy, or MSc Medical Anatomy with PhD/DSc) from a recognised teaching institute.
  • Experience: At least 3 years' teaching experience as Senior Resident/Tutor/Demonstrator/Registrar/Assistant Professor/Lecturer in the specialty after the first PG degree.
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: Delhi (liable to serve anywhere in India).

2. Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine)

  • Age: 40 years for UR/EWS; 43 years for OBC; 45 years for SC/ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Recognised MBBS degree plus Postgraduate degree in Medicine/General Medicine (MD/DNB) from a recognised teaching institute.
  • Experience: At least 3 years' teaching experience as Senior Resident/Tutor/Demonstrator/Registrar/Assistant Professor/Lecturer in the specialty after the first PG degree. (Note: experience as General Duty Medical Officer/Medical Officer is not counted.)
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: Delhi (liable to serve anywhere in India).

3. Assistant Editor (Indian Bureau of Mines)

  • Age: 30 years for UR; 35 years for SC; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Journalism/Mass Communication, OR Bachelor's degree with Economics/Statistics/English plus a 1-year diploma in Journalism/Mass Communication.
  • Experience: 3 years' experience editing and publishing in a publishing house, newspaper, news agency, publicity organisation, or government organisation.
  • Desirable: Master's degree in Mass Communication/Journalism/Economics/Statistics/English; experience with publishing software (PageMaker, MS Office, CorelDraw, QuarkXPress, Photoshop).
  • Pay Scale: Level-07 (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: Nagpur, Maharashtra (service liability anywhere in India).

4. Specialist Grade II (Junior Scale) – Anaesthesiology (NDMC)

  • Age: 50 years for ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Recognised medical qualification (MBBS-equivalent) plus PG degree/diploma in Anaesthesiology (MD/MS Anaesthesiology, DA, FFARCS, or equivalent).
  • Experience: 3 years' experience after PG degree, or 5 years' after PG diploma.
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: New Delhi Municipal Council.

5. Specialist Grade-II (Junior Scale) – Paediatrics (NDMC)

  • Age: 45 years for EWS; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Recognised medical qualification plus PG degree/diploma in Paediatrics (MD Paediatrics, or Diploma Paed./DCH).
  • Experience: 3 years' experience after PG degree, or 5 years' after PG diploma.
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: New Delhi Municipal Council.

6. Assistant Public Prosecutor (Govt. of NCT of Delhi)

  • Age: 35 years for UR/EWS; 38 years for OBC; 40 years for SC/ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD. Contractual employees get a one-time relaxation up to 5 years (subject to conditions).
  • Qualification: Degree in Law from a recognised University/Institute.
  • Experience: 3 years' experience at the bar.
  • Desirable: Experience as a government advocate.
  • Pay Scale: Level-10 (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: National Capital Territory of Delhi.
  • Mandatory induction training of at least 2 weeks for direct recruits.

7. Public Law Officer/District Litigation Officer/Law Officer (UT of Ladakh)

  • Age: 40 years for ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Law (Professional or Integrated) from a university established by law in India, with 2 years' actual practice at the bar, certified by the Principal District & Sessions Judge or Registrar General of the concerned High Court/Supreme Court.
  • Pay Scale: Level-8 (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: UT of Ladakh.
  • Domicile requirement: Recruitment is exclusive to Domiciles of the UT of Ladakh under the Ladakh Civil Services Decentralization and Recruitment – Grant of Domicile Certificate (Procedure) Rules, 2025. A valid Domicile Certificate issued by the Tehsildar is mandatory.
  • Reservation governed by the Jammu & Kashmir Reservation Act, 2004 (as extended/amended for Ladakh), covering ST, SC, Residents of Areas Adjoining the Actual Line of Control (ALC), EWS, and PwBD.

For all posts, the qualifications shown are relaxable at UPSC's discretion for otherwise well-qualified candidates, and experience requirements may be relaxed for SC/ST candidates if sufficient qualified candidates from these communities are not available.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Application Fee

  • Fee payable: ₹25 (Rupees Twenty-Five only), via Visa/MasterCard/RuPay Credit/Debit Card/UPI or internet banking.
  • Women candidates, and candidates belonging to SC, ST or Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) of any community, are exempted from fee payment.
  • No fee exemption is available to OBC/EWS/Unreserved male candidates - they must pay the full fee.
  • Applications without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected, with no representation entertained.
  • Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination/selection.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Age Relaxation & Concessions

  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years' relaxation; OBC candidates: 3 years' relaxation (for posts reserved for them).
  • PwBD candidates: 10 years' relaxation (cumulative with SC/ST/OBC relaxation where applicable), subject to maximum age on closing date not exceeding 56 years.
  • Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers (incl. ECOs/SSCOs): 5 years' relaxation, subject to minimum 6 months' continuous service after attestation as on closing date.
  • Central/UT Government servants: up to 5 years' relaxation (10 years for SC/ST, 8 years for OBC in posts reserved for them), subject to 3 years' continuous service in an allied cadre.
  • Scribe facility is available for specified categories of PwBD candidates in Recruitment Tests, subject to conditions.

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Selection Process

  • Recruitment is "by Selection" - primarily interview-based. Mere possession of the essential qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.
  • Where the number of applications is large, UPSC may apply shortlisting criteria: Desirable Qualifications, higher educational qualification, higher/relevant experience, or by holding a Recruitment Test (RT).
  • Minimum level of suitability in interview (out of 100 marks): UR – 50 marks, OBC – 45 marks, SC/ST/PH – 40 marks.
  • Where a Recruitment Test (RT) precedes the interview, candidates must clear the minimum suitability level at both the RT and interview stages.
  • Recruitment Test/Combined Recruitment Test (if held) will ordinarily be conducted at: Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi, and Visakhapatnam (for the Ladakh post: Leh, Kargil, Srinagar, and Delhi).
  • Shortlisted candidates must send self-attested copies of documents/certificates as and when demanded by the Commission.
  • Summoning for interview does not guarantee selection. Appointment orders are issued by the Government after final selection.
  • UPSC may grant higher initial pay to candidates adjudged meritorious in the interview.

How to Apply for UPSC Advt No. 11/2026

  1. Visit https://upsconline.nic.in and complete Account Creation, Universal Registration (to generate a Universal Registration Number, URN), and the Common Application Form (CAF) - these three modules are common to all UPSC recruitments and can be filled anytime.
  2. Fill the fourth, post/vacancy-specific module during the notified application window for this advertisement.
  3. Capture a live photograph as prompted while filling the CAF (in addition to uploading a photograph), ensuring it meets the Commission's photo/signature guidelines.
  4. Sign three times (one below the other) on plain white paper in black ink and upload the scanned signature.
  5. Upload supporting documents for each claim (date of birth, caste, educational qualification, experience, disability, desirable qualification, age relaxation, etc.) separately, in PDF format, in the prescribed proforma where applicable.
  6. Use Aadhaar as your ID document where possible for smoother verification; alternatively use Voter Card/PAN/Passport/Driving Licence.
  7. Review all details carefully - applications cannot be withdrawn, and no correction/alteration/modification is allowed after submission.
  8. Submit the application before the closing date: 02.10.2026 (1800 hrs) for all posts except the Ladakh post, or 09.10.2026 for the Ladakh post.
  9. Take a printout of the finally submitted application for your records - do not send it to UPSC by post; bring it only if called for interview, along with original documents.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Important Instructions

  • A candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee (pre-1962), or a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with intent to permanently settle in India - subject to eligibility certificate requirements for the latter categories.
  • The date for determining eligibility in every respect is the closing date for submission of the online application.
  • All correspondence from the Commission will be through the registered email ID only - candidates must furnish a correct, active email address.
  • PwBD candidates can apply for posts identified as "suitable" even if not reserved for them, and will be considered on general standard of merit; reservation/relaxation benefits apply only where the disability is 40% or more.
  • Candidates already in regular Central/State Government service must submit a declaration that they have informed their Head of Office/Department in writing about applying.
  • Furnishing false particulars, suppressing material information, tampering with documents, impersonation, or using unfair means will lead to disqualification and possible debarment from future UPSC examinations/selections and Central Government employment.
  • Candidates called for interview will get Commission's contribution towards travel, restricted to Second/Sleeper Class train fare (Mail/Express), paid via NEFT/bank details submitted at the interview.
  • Mobile phones, pagers, programmable devices, smart watches, cameras, or Bluetooth devices are strictly banned in the examination/interview hall.
  • Face authentication is mandatory for all candidates at the examination venue/interview hall.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.
  • Government strives for a gender-balanced workforce; women candidates are encouraged to apply.

Finance CA/CMA, OR a full-time graduation degree in Commerce/Accounting/Finance (B.Com, BMS, BAF, BBA) plus a 2-year full-time MBA/MMS/PGDM with specialisation in Finance. M.Com alone is not considered. No percentage criteria for CA/CMA; 60% for the postgraduate route (55% for SC/ST)
Marketing Full-time Science/Engineering/Agriculture graduate plus a 2-year full-time MBA/MMS/PGDM with specialisation in Marketing or Agri-Business Management/Agriculture 60% (55% for SC/ST)

For all disciplines, wherever CGPA/OGPA/SGPA or a letter grade is awarded, candidates must convert it to an equivalent percentage as per the norms of their university or institute and mention this in the application. Candidates in the final year of graduation or post-graduation are not eligible to apply.

RCF Management Trainee Age Limit

The upper age limit is calculated as on 01.02.2026 and varies by category. The general pattern followed across most disciplines is given below; a few posts (such as Boiler, Materials, CC Lab, Rajbhasha, Civil, and Fire) have narrower category-specific age limits because reservation is not notified for every category in those posts. Candidates should refer to the specific post-code table in the official notification for the exact age limit applicable to their category and discipline.

Category Upper Age Limit (general pattern, most disciplines)
UR / EWS 27 years
OBC (NCL) 30 years
SC / ST 32 years
PwBD (UR/EWS) Up to 37 years, where notified for the post
PwBD (SC/ST) Up to 42 years, where notified for the post
PwBD (OBC-NCL) Up to 40 years, where notified for the post

An additional age relaxation of 5 years is available to children/family members of victims of the 1984 riots, across all categories. Age relaxation for SC/ST and OBC(NCL) candidates applying against reserved posts is up to 5 years and 3 years respectively; PwBD candidates get further relaxation as specified in the notification.

RCF Management Trainee Salary

Selected candidates undergo a one-year training period and are paid a lump sum stipend of ₹60,000 per month during this period. Free hostel accommodation on a sharing basis is provided at Trombay/Thal, along with medical facility at the RCF Hospital.

On successful completion of training, trainees are absorbed in the E1 Grade with a pay scale of ₹40,000–₹140,000. The minimum total monthly gross emoluments (Basic Pay + VDA at 51.80% + Perks at 34% + HRA at 30% and other allowances) work out to approximately ₹86,320. Management Trainees posted outside Trombay and Thal (such as at Marketing Area Offices) additionally receive a fixed allowance of ₹5,000 per month towards boarding, lodging, and local travel, plus TA/DA on tours.

A bond amount of ₹2 lakh must be deposited by the Management Trainee at the time of joining as a fixed deposit with lien marked to RCF Ltd, for a period of 4 years including the one-year training period. On absorption, employees also become eligible for company accommodation (subject to availability), Performance Related Pay, free medical facility for self and dependents, gratuity, contributory provident fund, accident insurance, and pension scheme as per company rules.

RCF Management Trainee Application Fee

Category Application Fee
General / OBC (NCL) / EWS ₹1,000 plus applicable bank charges and GST
SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / PwBD / Female candidates Exempted - no application fee

Fees can be paid online only, through internet banking, debit card, or credit card. Once paid, the application fee is non-refundable under any circumstances, so candidates are advised to verify their eligibility before making the payment.

Also Read: BPCL Non Management Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 154 Technician & Operator Posts

RCF Management Trainee Selection Process

The RCF Management Trainee Selection Process consists of an Online Test followed by a Personal Interview.

Online Test

  • Computer-based objective test of 90 minutes, with 100 questions in total.
  • 50 questions (2 marks each) are from the course curriculum of the relevant discipline/qualifying degree.
  • 50 questions (1 mark each) cover General English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, and General Knowledge/Awareness.
  • There is negative marking for wrong answers.
  • The test is conducted in Hindi (Rajbhasha) and English, at centres in Bhopal, Delhi/Delhi NCR, Lucknow, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Guwahati, Kolkata, Mumbai/Navi Mumbai/Thane/MMR region, and Nagpur.

Personal Interview

  • Based on online test performance and document verification, eligible candidates are provisionally called for interview in a ratio of approximately 1:7 (7 candidates per post).
  • Candidates must score a minimum average of 50% in the interview to qualify.
  • Outstation candidates are reimbursed III-tier AC train/bus fare for both the online test and interview, as per the terms in the notification.

Final Merit List

Parameter Weightage
Online Test 80%
Personal Interview 20%

Separate category-wise and discipline-wise merit lists are prepared. Candidates with nil or negative marks in the online test are not eligible for interview. Final selection is also subject to a pre-employment medical examination and document verification.

RCF Management Trainee Required Documents

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm) as per specified scan requirements
  • Signature scanned on white paper with black ink
  • Left thumb impression on white paper with black or blue ink
  • Handwritten declaration (in the candidate's own handwriting, in English) as per the format given in the notification
  • Valid photo identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Aadhaar, etc. - Ration Card and Learner's Licence are not accepted)
  • Caste certificate in the prescribed proforma, where applicable (SC/ST/OBC-NCL)
  • Income and Asset Certificate for EWS candidates, issued on or after 1 April 2025
  • Disability certificate for PwBD candidates, as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC), for candidates currently employed in Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets relevant to the applied discipline

How to Apply for RCF Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official RCF website, www.rcfltd.com, and click on "Apply Online".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Fill in the application form, using "Save and Next" to complete it in stages if required.
  4. Upload the scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the specifications in the notification.
  5. Upload other required documents (single combined PDF file per category, maximum 500 KB) as listed in the advertisement.
  6. Preview and validate all details before clicking "Complete Registration".
  7. Pay the application fee online, where applicable, and take a printout of the e-receipt.
  8. Click "Submit" to complete the RCF Management Trainee Apply Online process.

RCF Management Trainee Apply Online: Important Instructions

  • Only online applications are accepted; physical application forms will not be considered.
  • Details submitted in the online application form, including correspondence address, email address, mobile number, category, post applied for, and test city, cannot be changed after submission.
  • Candidates must possess a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active throughout the recruitment process, as all communication will be sent electronically.
  • Candidates already employed in Central/State Government, Quasi-Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must apply through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of interview.
  • RCF reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, or modify the recruitment process, and to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, without prior notice.
  • Any corrigendum or update will be published only on www.rcfltd.com under "HR → Recruitment"; no separate press advertisement will be issued.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams
  • Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer - recruited through UPSC, the highest field-level forestry cadre in India

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts

Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.
