Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

Law Govt Jobs FAQ's

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. The table above is updated daily with vacancy count, last date, and the official notification link.

Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Bank of India (BOI), a leading Public Sector Bank with its Head Office in Mumbai, has released a notification for the recruitment of Officers in various Specialist streams up to Scale IV. Under Project No. 2026-27/02 dated 01.08.2026, BOI is inviting applications for 205 vacancies across 48 distinct posts ranging from Officer (Scale I) to Chief Manager (Scale IV). Candidates with qualifications in Computer Science/IT, Law, Fire Engineering, and Civil Engineering can apply online between 10.09.2026 and 25.09.2026.

In brief: BOI is recruiting for IT and specialist officer roles spanning Full-Stack Engineering, Digital Platforms, Information Security, DevSecOps, Data Engineering, Database Administration, Law Officer, Fire Officer, Security Officer, and Civil Engineer, among others. Eligible Indian citizens (and other nationalities specified in the notice) meeting the post-specific qualification and experience criteria as on 01.08.2026 can apply online through the official BOI website. The application mode is online only, and postings will be anywhere in India.

Bank of India Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational qualification is broadly B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc (Computer Science or Information Technology) for the IT and digital-banking posts, LLB for Law Officer, a recognised Fire/Safety Engineering degree for Fire Officer, and a B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering for Civil Engineer. Post-qualification work experience requirements range from 1 year (Scale I) to a minimum of 8 years with domain-specific experience (Scale IV). Each of the 48 posts also carries its own mandatory/preferred professional certifications (examples: OCP Java, CISA/CISM/CISSP, PMP, TOGAF, AWS/Azure certifications, CKA, ITIL) - these are post-specific and detailed in full in Annexure-I to the Notice.

Post Name Qualification
Chief Manager – Full-Stack Engineering B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / Electronics & Communication OR MCA (3 years Full-time) OR M.Sc. in Computer Science / Information Technology. Mandatory: At least one of Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) Java SE Programmer-21 & above / equivalent React JS certification, Meta Front-End Developer Professional Certificate / equivalent Node JS certification, MERN Stack certification, or Certified Professional Python Programmer. Preferred: AWS Certified Developer – Associate / Microsoft Azure Developer Associate; Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) / SAFe Agilist.
Chief Manager – Digital Platforms B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / Electronics & Communication OR MCA (3 years Full-time) OR M.Sc. in Computer Science / Information Technology. BOI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Online Examination: English Language (25 marks, qualifying only) + Professional Knowledge relevant to the post (100 marks), composite duration 100 minutes
  • Minimum qualifying marks: 35% for General/EWS (30% for SC/ST/OBC/PWD)
  • Personal Interview: Maximum 100 marks; qualifying 50% for General/EWS, 45% for SC/ST/OBC/PWD; candidates called at approximately 1:3 ratio to vacancies
  • Final weightage: Online Examination and Interview combined at 60:40
  • Bank may, at its discretion, select solely through Interview without an online exam

  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-Non-Creamy Layer/EWS/PWD), as applicable
  • Experience certificates and mandatory certification proofs relevant to the post applied for
  • No Objection Certificate (for candidates in government/PSU employment)

How to Apply for Bank of India Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official website www.bankofindia.bank.in and click on 'CAREER'
  2. Click the link "Recruitment of Officers in various streams upto Scale IV – Project No. 2026-27/02 Notice dated 01.08.2026"
  3. Click 'APPLY ONLINE' and complete new registration to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password
  4. Fill in personal, educational, and experience details; upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration as per specifications
  5. Preview and verify all details before clicking 'COMPLETE REGISTRATION'
  6. Pay the application fee/intimation charges online
  7. Take a printout of the system-generated application form and e-receipt for personal record

Important Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for only one post; multiple applications will retain only the latest valid one
  • Candidates already holding a similar post in Bank of India in the past are not eligible
  • No change of category or other application details is permitted after registration
  • Selected candidates must deposit a refundable security deposit: ₹1,00,000 (JMGS-I), ₹2,00,000 (MMGS-II), ₹3,00,000 (MMGS-III and above)
  • All mandatory certifications must be valid as on 01.08.2026
  • Bank reserves the right to change, cancel, or modify vacancies, posts, or the selection process at any stage

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for the Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks, 15th cycle (CRP RRBs-XV), inviting online applications for Group "A" Officer (Scale-I, II & III) and Group "B" Office Assistant (Multipurpose) posts across 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) in India. IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 online registration opens on 1 September 2026 and closes on 21 September 2026.

Quick answer: IBPS is recruiting for Officer Scale-I, II (seven specialisations), III, and Office Assistant (Multipurpose) posts, with an indicative 13,706 vacancies spread across 28 RRBs covering nearly every state and union territory of India. Graduates in any discipline (with specific additional qualifications for certain Officer Scale-II specialist roles) between 18 and 40 years of age (depending on the post) can apply online only, from 1 September 2026 to 21 September 2026, at the official IBPS website, www.ibps.in.

The Export-Import Bank of India (Exim Bank), an all-India premier financial institution engaged in financing, facilitating and promoting India's international trade, has invited applications for its Special Recruitment Drive (SRD) for Backlog Vacancies, vide Advertisement No. HRM/DM & M/SRD/2026-27/04.

This Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 covers a total of 8 posts across Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I – Banking Operations) and Manager (Grade/Scale MM II – Internal Audit), against SC, ST, and OBC backlog vacancies. Only Indian citizens are eligible to apply. The online application link will be live from 15 September 2026 to 10 October 2026, and no other mode of application will be accepted. The written examination is tentatively scheduled for November 2026, to be held at Chennai, Kolkata, Mumbai, New Delhi, and Guwahati, with personal interviews conducted in Mumbai and New Delhi.

Download Official Notification | Apply Online

Posts Deputy Manager (JM I), Manager (MM II)
Total Vacancies 8

Tentative Month of Written Examination November 2026*

Note: The exact examination date will be advised through the call letter and updated on the Bank's website. No request for change of centre, venue, date, or session will be entertained.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Vacancy 2026

A total of 8 vacancies have been notified under this Special Recruitment Drive for backlog posts, as shown below. Reservations are applicable as per prevailing Government of India guidelines, and the reservation for PwBD candidates is on a horizontal basis for Hearing Impairment (HI) disability.

Position (Grade/Scale) SC ST OBC Total
Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I) 2 1 3 6*
Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) - 2 - 2*

Note: The reservation for PwBD candidates is on a horizontal basis for Hearing Impairment (HI) disability.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility (age, educational qualification, etc.) is computed as on 31-08-2026, as detailed below for each post.

Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) – Internal Audit (2 Posts)

Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA). The Post Graduation course should be a minimum 2-year full-time duration with a specialization in Finance and minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA. For CA, passing the professional examination is sufficient, and membership of ICAI is mandatory.

Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in a scheduled commercial bank, an all-India financial institution, or another organization of repute, in internal audit / credit audit, including handling preparation and submission of reports by internal/concurrent auditors, audit compliance, analysis and timely submission of audit observations to the audit committee, review of internal/concurrent audit scope and systems/procedures/controls, and experience dealing with RBI on audit/inspection matters (in Scale I or equivalent).

Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I) – Banking Operations (6 Posts)

Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA), on the same terms as above.

Experience (as on 31-08-2026): Minimum 1 year of post-qualification (Post Graduation or CA) work experience in a reputed commercial bank / financial institution / state level term lending institution, with skills in project finance, credit appraisal, term lending, analysis of cross-border risks, and financing of overseas joint ventures.

Other Eligibility Notes

  • Candidates should possess excellent communication skills and be proficient in computers and information technology.
  • Candidates from universities awarding CGPA/GPA instead of numerical marks must furnish a conversion letter from the head of the institute / controller of examination if the equivalent percentage is not mentioned on the marksheet.
  • The university/institute must be recognised/approved by the Government / AICTE / UGC.
  • Candidates who completed graduation or post-graduation through correspondence / part-time / open university / open learning / external / distance / e-learning are not eligible.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Selection Process

Selection comprises a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.

Structure of Written Test

Name of Test Section No. of Questions Max. Marks Time
Professional Knowledge – Subjective Part I – Question 1 (Compulsory) 1 40 2 hours 30 minutes
Part II – Attempt any 6 out of 8 Questions 6 (of 8) 60
Total 100 2 hours 30 minutes

There is no sectional cut-off; the final list for interviews is drawn based on the candidate's overall performance in the written test. Final selection is based on combined performance in the Written Examination (out of 100, with 70% weightage) and the Interview (out of 100, with 30% weightage). A pre-recruitment training will be organised for candidates from reserved categories who opt for it through the online application form.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only, from 15 September 2026 to 10 October 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Visit the Bank's Online Application page and click "APPLY ONLINE."

  3. Fill in the application form; use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress before final submission, since no changes are possible after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION."
  4. Upload your Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per the prescribed specifications.
  5. Fill in remaining details, preview the application, and click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" only after verifying all details.
  6. Proceed to the "Payment" tab and complete the online fee payment, then click "Submit."
  7. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

Note: Candidates can apply for only one post. If a candidate applies for more than one post, only the latest valid (completed) application/registration will be retained, and fees paid for other registrations will stand forfeited.

  • OBC caste certificates must specifically contain the non-creamy layer clause and must be valid (issued within one year prior to) the last date of applying.

United India Insurance Company Limited (UIIC), a Government of India-owned Public Sector General Insurance Company, has released the UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 notification for the post of Administrative Officer (Scale I). The recruitment covers two disciplines - Generalists and Hindi Officers - with a combined 225 provisional vacancies. Online registration for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 begins on 8th September 2026 and closes on 28th September 2026.

Eligible Indian citizens (and specified categories under Nationality rules) who meet the age and qualification criteria as on 30.06.2026 can apply online through the official website, uiic.co.in. Below is a complete breakdown of UIIC AO vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, application fee, salary, selection process, and how to apply.

UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Recruiting Organisation United India Insurance Company Limited (UIIC), a Government of India Undertaking
Post Name Administrative Officer (Scale I) – Generalists & Hindi Officers
Reference Number HO:HRM:REC:AO:1:2026
Notification Date 07.09.2026
Total Vacancies 225 (200 Generalists + 25 Hindi Officers) – provisional
Application Mode Online only
Age Limit (as on 30.06.2026) 21 to 30 years
Application Start Date 8th September 2026
Last Date to Apply Online 28th September 2026
Job Location Offices across India; vacancies substantially in Western and Southern Zones
Official Website uiic.co.in

Event Date
Online Registration Commences 8th September 2026

Last Date for Payment of Application Fee/Service Charges 28th September 2026

Tier I: Preliminary Examination (Online Objective Test) 22nd October 2026 (tentative)
Tier II: Main Examination (Online Objective Test + Descriptive Test) 30th November 2026 (tentative)

UIIC AO Vacancy Details

UIIC has announced 225 provisional vacancies for Administrative Officer (Scale I) across two disciplines. The category-wise breakup, including the 4% horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD), is given below. Note that these numbers are provisional and may vary as per the notification.

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts
1 Administrative Officer – Generalists 200 (UR-68, OBC-62, EWS-22, SC-30, ST-18; PwBD horizontal: VI-2, HI-2, OC-4, MD/ID-3)
2 Administrative Officer – Hindi Officers 25 (UR-11, OBC-7, EWS-2, SC-4, ST-1; PwBD horizontal: VI-1)

A candidate can apply for either Generalists or Hindi Officers, but not both. Multiple registrations or appearances will lead to cancellation of candidature. Candidates currently serving as Administrative Officers (Scale-I) in UIIC are not eligible to apply.

Also Read: Bank of Baroda SO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 1100 Wealth Executive, Credit Analyst Posts

UIIC AO Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the Nationality/Citizenship condition as on the date of application. A candidate must be either a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, a subject of Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1st January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, or Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India. Candidates in the last four categories must hold an eligibility certificate issued by the Government of India.

UIIC AO Qualification

The minimum educational qualification must have been obtained on or before 30.06.2026 from a recognised university or institute, approved by UGC/AICTE, through the 10+2+3 pattern or an equivalent system. Working knowledge of computers is mandatory for all candidates.

Discipline Minimum Educational Qualification
Generalists Graduate or Postgraduate degree in any discipline (including Engineering, Arts, Science, Commerce, Agriculture, Data Science, etc.) from a recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD category)
Hindi Officers Master’s Degree from a recognised university with Hindi and English in any of the specified combinations (as compulsory/elective subject or medium of examination) at the degree level, with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD category)

Where only CGPA/OGPA/SGPA is awarded, candidates must produce a conversion certificate from the university; a fraction such as 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%.

UIIC AO Age Limit

As on 30.06.2026, the minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 30 years. Candidates must have been born not earlier than 30.06.1996 and not later than 30.06.2005 (both dates inclusive). Upper age relaxation is available as follows, subject to a cumulative cap of 45 years.

Category Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe 5 Years
Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 Years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities 10 Years
Ex-servicemen (with at least 5 years military service) 5 Years
Defence personnel disabled in operations 3 Years
Widows, divorced women, and women legally separated (not remarried) 9 Years
Existing confirmed employees of Public Sector General Insurance Companies (incl. GIC & Agriculture Insurance Company of India Ltd.) 8 Years

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

UIIC AO Application Fee

The application fee/service charges are non-refundable under any circumstances, once paid.

Category of Applicant Amount (Non-Refundable)
All applicants other than SC/ST/PwBD/permanent employees of UIIC ₹1,000/- (application fee including service charges) + GST as applicable
SC/ST/PwBD/permanent employees of UIIC Application fee: Nil. ₹250/- (service charges only) + GST as applicable

Also Read: PMBI Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Offline for 178 Pharmacist, Executive and More Posts

UIIC AO Salary

Selected candidates will draw basic pay in the scale of ₹82,485-4050(14)-139185-4390(4)-156745, along with other admissible allowances. In addition to emoluments, the Company provides Gratuity, LTS, Medical Benefits, Group Personal Accident Insurance, and National Pension System (NPS), with leased accommodation extended as per Company rules. Gross pay is approximately ₹1,10,000 per month at Metropolitan centres.

Selected candidates will serve a probation period of one year (extendable at the Company’s discretion) and must pass the non-life Licentiate Examination conducted by the Insurance Institute of India during probation. Candidates must also execute a guarantee bond to serve the Company for a minimum of five years, including the probation period; early resignation attracts liquidated damages plus a ₹35,000 onboarding and integration cost.

UIIC AO Selection Process

Selection for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026 is through a three-stage process: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and Interview.

  • Tier I – Preliminary Examination (Qualifying, 100 marks, 60 minutes): English Language (30 questions/30 marks), Reasoning (35/35), Quantitative Aptitude (35/35).
  • Tier II – Main Examination for Generalists: Objective Test of 250 marks (English Language, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness with special reference to the Financial Sector, and Computer Knowledge – 200 questions, 150 minutes) followed by a Descriptive Test of 30 marks (Letter Writing and Essay, 30 minutes).
  • Tier II – Main Examination for Hindi Officers: Objective Test of 200 marks (English Language, Reasoning, Professional Knowledge of Hindi/English, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge – 150 questions, 120 minutes) followed by a Descriptive Test of 50 marks (English/Hindi essay, letter writing, and translation, 60 minutes).
  • Interview: Candidates qualifying the Main Examination are called for interview, up to three times the vacancies in the respective category/discipline.

For Generalists, the final merit list is prepared using Main Examination Objective Test marks and Interview marks in the ratio 75:25; Preliminary and Descriptive Test marks are not counted for merit. For Hindi Officers, the Main Examination (Objective + Descriptive) and Interview marks are considered in the ratio 75:25; Preliminary Examination marks are not counted for merit. There is a penalty of one-fourth of the marks assigned to a question for each wrong answer in the objective tests.

Documents Required

  • Scanned photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm, colour, light background)
  • Scanned signature in black ink (not in capital letters)
  • Scanned left thumb impression on white paper with black or blue ink
  • Handwritten declaration in English, in the candidate’s own handwriting, as per the prescribed format
  • Valid Call Letter and original Photo Identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter’s Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, or similar accepted ID) at the time of examination and interview
  • Category/community, age, and educational qualification certificates, as applicable, at the time of interview

Ration cards and Learner’s Driving Licences are not accepted as valid photo ID proof.

How to Apply for UIIC AO Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the Recruitment section on the UIIC official website and click on “Apply Online”.
  2. Choose “Click here for New Registration” and enter your name, contact details, and email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
  3. Log in and fill in the application form, using the “Save and Next” option to complete it in stages.
  4. Upload your photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the specified format and size.
  5. Preview the completed application form and verify all details carefully.
  6. Click “Complete Registration” only after confirming all details are correct, as no changes are permitted afterward.
  7. Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the applicable application fee/service charges online.
  8. Click “Submit” and take a printout of the system-generated application form and payment receipt for future reference.

  • Candidates should apply well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Detailed Job Descriptions 

Field Collection Officer / Collection FOS (DRA Certified)

Supports Bank of Baroda's receivable management and recovery operations through field visits and customer interactions for timely recovery of overdue payments, in compliance with RBI guidelines and the Fair Practices Code. Responsibilities include visiting allocated customers, negotiating repayment plans, resolving queries, maintaining records, escalating disputed cases, and achieving monthly productivity/recovery/quality targets. Possession of a two-wheeler and valid driving licence is required. Job location: PAN India.

Digital Onboarding Specialist (Part-Time)

Assists walk-in branch customers in adopting the Bank's digital banking ecosystem — mobile banking, internet banking, UPI, and digital applications for FDs, RDs, loans, insurance, investment products, and credit cards. Also supports digital service requests (KYC updates, cheque books, nominee updates, etc.). This is a part-time role (6 hours, 10:30 AM–4:30 PM), open to freshers. Job location: PAN India.

Aadhaar Operator (Part-Time)

Performs Aadhaar enrolment and update processes, captures biometric data (fingerprints, iris scan, photograph), verifies identity documents, enters demographic details as per UIDAI standards, and maintains data privacy. Requires an active NSEIT certificate and basic computer/typing skills. Job location: PAN India, including AEC centres and enrolment camps.

Executive – Debit Card Operations / ATM-Reconciliation-Complaints

The job description document details a related "Executive – Debit Card Operations (Issuance/Reconciliation/Disputes)" profile under Digital Banking at Vadodara, matching the notice's separate Debit Card Operations role (10 posts). No separate detailed JD was found for the "Executive – ATM/Reconciliation/Complaints/Debit Cards" role (40 posts, Alkapuri, Vadodara) listed in the notice.

Sales Officer/ASM/RSM – Loan Sales

Covers day-to-day sales management for Home/Auto/Education/Tractor loans, including empanelling and developing sales teams, achieving sales/cross-sell targets through SO/SSO and dealer channels, managing client relationships, and ensuring compliance with NHB/RBI regulations. A Graduate degree is mandatory; minimum 3 years of relevant experience (ASM level) or 1–3 years (Direct Sales Executive level). Job location: PAN India, including Mumbai, Bengaluru, NCR, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, and Baroda.

Tele-Collection / Collections Executive

Manages large volumes of outbound calls for overdue payment collection, following communication scripts, identifying customer needs, and meeting individual/team collection targets. DRA certification is required; candidates should not be pursuing further studies. Experience required: minimum 0–5 years (varies by seniority — Executive/Senior Executive, Assistant Manager, or Trainer-level roles have differing experience requirements as detailed in the source JDs). Locations: GIFT City-Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Bangalore, and Manjalpur-Vadodara depending on the specific sub-role.

MIS Analyst / Contact Center MIS Executive

Manages data for client reporting, dashboards (daily/weekly/monthly), campaign and dialer data management, automation of reports, and statistical/performance feedback to operations. Requires graduation and advanced MS Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI). Job location: GIFT City, Gandhinagar.

Procurement Manager / Assistant Manager – Procurement

Executes procurement and tendering processes (e-Tendering via GeM, open/limited tenders, rate contracts), ensures compliance with GFR 2017, CVC guidelines, and internal procurement policy, supports vendor management, and maintains procurement MIS. Minimum Graduate required, MBA (Finance/Operations/Supply Chain) preferred, with minimum 5 years of relevant experience. Job location: Gift City, Gandhinagar.

Desktop Support Analyst / IT Support Engineer

Provides Level 1 & Level 2 technical support for hardware, software, and network issues; manages IT tickets, endpoint/asset management, Active Directory/Microsoft 365 administration, and network troubleshooting. Requires graduation plus CompTIA A+ or equivalent and Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (or equivalent) certifications, with minimum 3+ years of experience.

SBI SCO Application Fee

The application fee and intimation charges (non-refundable) are ₹750 for UR/EWS/OBC candidates; there is no fee for SC/ST/PwBD candidates. Fees must be paid online through the payment gateway integrated with the application, using Debit Card, Credit Card, or Internet Banking. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded or adjusted for any other examination or selection.

SBI SCO Selection Process

  • Shortlisting: mere fulfilment of minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview; the shortlisting committee decides the parameters and number of candidates called.
  • Interview: one or more rounds of personal, telephonic, or video interview, carrying 100 marks; the qualifying marks are decided by the Bank.
  • CTC Negotiation: conducted individually with shortlisted candidates, at the time of interview or after completion of the interview process.
  • Merit List: prepared in descending order based on interview scores only; candidates tied at the cut-off mark are ranked by age, in descending order.

  3. Scan and upload your latest photograph and signature as specified; the application will not register without these.
  4. Upload all relevant documents, including resume, ID proof, age proof, caste certificate, PwBD certificate (if applicable), educational qualification certificates, experience certificates, and biodata.
  5. Fill the application carefully, note the system-generated registration number and password, and pay the application fee online through the integrated payment gateway.
  6. Take a printout of the submitted application form and the fee e-receipt for your records; no changes are allowed after final submission.

Candidates should apply well before the closing date, 25-09-2026, to avoid last-minute technical issues. Hard copies of the application and documents need not be sent to the Bank.

The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has issued an official notice regarding the tentative schedule of the Computer Based Test (CBT) for the post of Section Controller under CEN No. 03/2026. According to the notice, the CBT is scheduled to be held from 12 October 2026 to 13 October 2026. The notice, dated 11 September 2026, was issued by the Chairpersons of the Railway Recruitment Boards and is available on the official RRB website.

Direct link to Check RRB Section Controller Exam Date 2026

RRB Section Controller Exam Date 2026 - Important Dates

As per the notice, the following schedule applies. All dates other than the CBT dates are described as "tentative" in the original notice.

Event Date / Timeline
Computer Based Test (CBT) 12 October 2026 to 13 October 2026 (tentative)
Notice Issue Date 11 September 2026

Required Documents and Aadhaar Verification Rules

The notice lays out specific Aadhaar-related requirements that candidates must complete before appearing for the exam:

  • Aadhaar-linked biometric authentication of candidates will be carried out at the exam center before entry into the exam hall.
  • Candidates must bring their original Aadhaar card or a printout of e-verified Aadhaar.
  • If Aadhaar authentication has not already been completed, candidates are advised to log in with their credentials at www.rrbapply.gov.in and complete Aadhaar verification to ensure smooth entry into the exam center.
  • Candidates including those who already verified Aadhaar during application submission must ensure their Aadhaar remains in an unlocked condition in the UIDAI system before coming to the exam centre, to avoid inconvenience during registration and exam-day processes.
  • The Aadhaar card should be updated with:
    • Correct name
    • Date of birth (as per Class 10th Certificate)
    • Latest photograph
    • Updated biometrics (if not updated after reaching the age of 15 years)
    • Correct address
    • Father's name

Also Read: RRB Technician Application Status 2026 Notice

How to Check the RRB Section Controller Exam City, Date and E-Call Letter

  1. Visit the official website of the concerned Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in.
  2. Look for the Exam City & Date Intimation link, which the notice says will be made live approximately 10 days before the exam date.
  3. SC/ST candidates can also download their Travel Authority from the same link once it is live.
  4. The E-Call Letter download will start approximately 4 days before the exam date mentioned in the Exam City and Date Intimation link.
  5. If Aadhaar verification is pending, log in at www.rrbapply.gov.in with your credentials and complete the authentication before the exam day.

Important Instructions from the Official Notice

  • Candidates are advised to refer only to the official websites of RRBs for the latest updates on the recruitment process, and not to be misled by unauthenticated sources.
  • Candidates should beware of touts who try to mislead them with fake promises of appointment through illegal consideration.
  • RRB selections are based only on the Computer Based Test (CBT), and recruitment is based purely on the merit of the candidates.
  • All exam dates and related timelines mentioned in this notice are tentative and subject to confirmation by RRB.

How to Raise an Objection Against the JKSSB Answer Key

JKSSB allows candidates to challenge the provisional answer key by submitting a representation in the prescribed format. The process is entirely offline.

  1. Download and fill the objection format given as Annexure "C" in the official notice.
  2. Use a separate form for each question being objected to combining multiple questions on one form means only the first entry will be considered.
  3. Attach documentary proof or evidence supporting the claimed correct answer (hard copies only).
  4. Prepare a Demand Draft of ₹200 per question, in favour of the Accounts Officer, J&K Services Selection Board.
  5. Submit the objection in person at the JKSSB office Muthi, Akhnoor Road, Jammu / JKSSB, Zamzam Building, Rambagh, Srinagar.
  6. Submit only within the three working days starting 11.09.2026, between 11:00 AM and 5:00 PM.

Also Read: IAF Agniveervayu Intake 02/2027 Exam City Intimation Slip 2026

Required Documents for Objection

  • Duly filled Annexure "C" representation form (one per question)
  • Documentary proof/evidence substantiating the claimed correct answer
  • Demand Draft of ₹200 per question, favouring the Accounts Officer, J&K Services Selection Board
  • Candidate's bank account number (16-digit) and IFSC code, as required in the form (for refund in case the objection is accepted)

Important Instructions

  • Objections/representations will be accepted in offline mode only; no online or email submissions will be entertained.
  • The fee of ₹200 per question is refundable only if the objection is found genuine/correct.
  • If an objection is accepted, the answer key will be revised for all candidates not just the one who raised it.
  • JKSSB will not individually inform candidates whether their objection was accepted or rejected.
  • No representation will be entertained after the stipulated three-working-day window or through any mode other than the one specified.
  • Use a separate page/format for each question objected to, or only the first question on the form will be considered.

How to Download GSSSB Provisional Answer Key & Response Sheet

Candidates can view their question paper, chosen responses, and the provisional answer key by logging into the portal linked in the official notice. Follow these steps:

  1. Open the login link: Visit the candidate login page provided in the official notice: Here
  2. Log in: Select your Advertisement Number, then enter your Confirmation Number, Date of Birth (DDMMYYYY), and the image/captcha text shown, and click "Login".
  3. Go to Candidate Response: On the dashboard, click the "Candidate Response" tab to load your question paper section.
  4. Generate your response sheet: Click the "here" link (to generate your question paper) to open your Participant ID, Participant Name, Test Center, Test Date, Test Time, Subject, and your response details.
  5. Save or print: Click "Print" and choose "Save as PDF" to save the Provisional Answer Key cum Response Sheet to your device. You may also take a physical printout.

How to Raise an Objection Against the GSSSB Answer Key

If a candidate disagrees with any answer in the provisional answer key, an objection can be submitted online within the objection window (10-16 September 2026). Only online objections are accepted; objections submitted through any other medium will not be considered.

  1. Go to the Objection Form: After logging in, click the "Objection Form" tab.
  2. Read the instructions: Click the "+" icon to view the objection instructions carefully before proceeding - this cannot be undone once submitted.
  3. Open the objection form: Click "Form to Raise Objection" and fill in your Confirmation Number, Roll Number, Applicant Name, Subject Name, Test Date, and Shift (most fields are auto-filled).
  4. Select the Question ID: Choose the Question ID (as shown on your Provisional Answer Key cum Response Sheet) that you want to object to, along with the language in which the question was answered.
  5. Select Type of Objection: Choose the relevant objection type. If you believe more than one option is correct for a question, select "Multiple correct answers" and enter up to 4 option IDs, separated by commas.
  6. Enter the correct answer key: State what you believe is the correct answer, and add remarks if you wish to explain your reasoning.
  7. Upload supporting proof: Attach documentary evidence - for example, the book name, page number, author's name, publisher's name/address, and year of publication - as a clear PDF/JPG/JPEG file, with each file under 400 KB. Up to 3 supporting documents can be uploaded per objection.
  8. Submit: Click "Submit" to finalize your objection.

Important Instructions for Raising Objections

  • Objections must be submitted online only; objections sent through any other medium will not be considered.
  • Only candidates who were present for the CBRT exam can submit an online objection.
  • A candidate can raise objections for more than one question.
  • Objections must reference the exact Question ID shown on the candidate's own Provisional Answer Key cum Response Sheet.
  • Objections, once submitted, cannot be edited later, so candidates should review their entry carefully before submitting.
  • Objections without a valid explanation or supporting reference will not be considered and will be discarded.
  • Uploading supporting proof/reference documents is mandatory before an objection can be submitted.
  • Supporting documents must be in PDF/JPG/JPEG format and within 400 KB in file size.

UPSC reviews all objections and issues the final answer key only after this process is complete. The final answer key is the one used for preparing results and cannot be challenged further.

Once the objection window closes, UPSC evaluates all valid representations and releases the final answer key. This is followed by the declaration of the Paper 1 result. About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026
